content.text:
I found one cause and fixed it. I haven't looked at the pages in a browser, so I haven't confirmed the site looks right again.

**Cause:** The `@font-face` rule in `site/css/tokens.css` pointed to `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the folder is `site/fonts/`. The font file never loaded, so every page fell back to the system font. That matches the whole site looking different, since all pages share that stylesheet.

**Fix:** I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. The server now returns the font file with a 200.

**Other checks:**
- No other broken `url()` references in the CSS.
- No undefined `var(--…)` tokens.
- All 16 functional tests pass. They don't check appearance, so they say nothing about the font.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't diff against the earlier version to see what changed. If something still looks off, tell me which page and what's different.

STATUS: DONE
